simple.meaning: לַהַב (lahab) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a flash ; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a flash ; figuratively, a sharply polished blade or point of a weapon
definitions.full: H3851. lahab לַ֫הַב noun masculine flame, blade ; — ׳ל absolute Judg 3:22 , 22 2 t.; construct 13:20 5 t.; plural לְהָבִים Isa 13:8 ; construct לַהֲבֵי 66:15 ; — 1 flame of altar, Judg 13:20 (twice in verse) ׳(ל הַמִּזְבֵּחַׅ ) ׳ל אוֺכְלָה אֵשׁ , of ׳י s is judgement Isa 29:6 ; 30:30 ; 66:15 (in all || forces of nature, whirlwind, thunder, earthquake, rain, hail, etc.); figurative ל ׳מְּנֵי מְּנֵיהֶם 13:8 (i.e. hot with excitement, compare Di); simile Joel 2:5 ל ׳כְּקוֺל אֵשׁ (of rush of locusts); figurative of breath of crocodile Job 41:13 . 2 of flashing point of spear Job 39:23 ; blade of sword Nahum 3:3 ; in prose, Judg 3:22 (twice in verse).
